method: Web research 2026-10-15 from search-engine summaries of the cited pages (pages not opened directly).
overview: Guidehouse is a consulting firm focused on highly regulated sectors: US federal and state government, defense and national security, healthcare, energy and financial services. It was formed in 2018 from PwC's public-sector practice and added Navigant's commercial business in 2019.

differentiators.text: Specialised in government and regulated industries (formed from PwC's public-sector arm, with Navigant's commercial practices added), including energy and sustainability work for utilities and agencies.
differentiators.significance: A route into public-sector or energy-transition strategy; less corporate-strategy work than a generalist firm.

employee_support.text: Job postings list parental leave and adoption assistance, emergency back-up childcare, dependent-care accounts and tuition reimbursement.
employee_support.significance: Back-up childcare and tuition support are documented; leave length not stated.

tradeoffs.text: Guidehouse was among the firms hit hardest by 2025 federal consulting contract cuts, and filed WARN layoff notices for its digital unit in 2025.
tradeoffs.significance: Federal demand is volatile; commercial and state-government roles carry different risk.
